name: fix-authority-smoke-cwd-isolation
title: Fix autopilot-authority and multi-host-authority smokes: isolate from authority_trust.env via fileReader
description: autopilot-authority-smoke and multi-host-authority-smoke fail when authority_trust.env exists in the project root. The smokes call resolveAuthorityVerdictBacking and buildAutopilotRun without cwd or fileReader isolation, so loadAuthorityConfig reads authority_trust.env from process.cwd() and picks up the real staging URL, turning unit-level safety assertions into failures. Fix: pass fileReader stub in affected call sites. Zero production code changes.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the word production appears in the description only to explain what is NOT being changed (zero production code changes). This story modifies only 2 smoke test files. No production handlers, core modules, or runtime paths are touched.
